description: Found 2026-08-22 while committing the issue #30 GUI follow-up work: 'git commit' hung indefinitely. Root cause: .githooks/kovan-bin.sh (sourced by prepare-commit-msg/post-commit) resolved KOVAN_BIN to target/release/kovan, then ran '$KOVAN_BIN tokens trailer <msgfile>' -- but since the 2026-08-21 3-binary restructure (issue #30), 'kovan' is the GUI binary (eframe window, gui feature on by default) and 'kovan-cli' is where tokens/historian/etc. actually live. Confirmed by hand: 'kovan --help' and 'kovan tokens trailer --help' both hang (a GUI process appears in ps aux); 'kovan-cli tokens trailer --help' returns immediately. The hook's own doc comment says 'NEVER BLOCK A COMMIT' but in practice it silently spawned a stray GUI window and hung. Fixed by changing kovan-bin.sh's search (PATH + target/release + target/debug) from 'kovan' to 'kovan-cli' in all three resolution steps. Already fixed and verified in this session -- filing for the record per the workspace's own hooks not being kopitiam's problem.
title: githooks: kovan-bin.sh resolved the GUI binary (kovan), not kovan-cli, hanging every commit

description:
**Numerical integration** on the hybrid backend — two distinct things, both
named by the maintainer under one heading, kept separate here because they
parallelise differently.

**(a) Quadrature.** No general quadrature module exists in the crate today.
Add one (`src/math/quadrature.rs` or `src/integration/`):

- Fixed-order Gauss-Legendre and Simpson/trapezoid on `[a, b]`, plus an
  adaptive variant on the CPU.
- The GPU-worthy shape is **N independent integrals evaluated at once** (one
  per cell/face/band), not one integral split across threads. Fixed-order rules
  are branch-free and map cleanly; adaptive subdivision does not — keep
  adaptive CPU-only and say why in the doc.
- A summation-order note is required: a parallel reduction is not
  bit-identical to serial accumulation.

**(b) ODE integration ensembles.** Existing serial code in `src/ode/` —
`euler.rs`, `rkf45.rs`, `rosenbrock23.rs`, `integrator.rs`.

- The parallel shape is an **ensemble**: N independent IVPs advanced together
  (per-cell chemistry/thermo relaxation, particle histories). One stiff ODE is
  inherently sequential in time and must stay serial.
- `rkf45` is adaptive-step, so an ensemble on the GPU either runs lockstep at
  the smallest step in the batch (wasteful but simple) or needs per-lane step
  control (correct but divergent). Pick one deliberately, document the choice,
  and measure the cost.
- `rosenbrock23` needs a Jacobian per lane — depends on the numerical
  differentiation work in the sibling bead.

V&V: integrals with closed-form values (polynomials exact to the Gauss order,
a Gaussian, a log singularity for the adaptive path); ODEs with analytic
solutions plus an order-of-convergence check that the observed order matches
the method's theoretical order. Record measured errors and the date.
title: outram-foam-basic-lib: numerical integration on the hybrid backend (batched quadrature + ODE ensembles)
